scientific_integrity: Proof is general, with independent exhaustive finite checks reported only for five parameter pairs. No independent external audit or broader code-family claim.
scientific_limitations: Binary rectangular single parity-check products and exact eight-erasure patterns only. d3=8 is known; contribution is structural ambiguity-rank classification and count. The 2019 exact Kostka formula enumerates strict patterns by degree margins but not their erasure-kernel rank; a 2016 complete eight-pattern enumeration was inaccessible and remains an originality risk.
title: Eight-erasure three-dimensional ambiguity in binary \(\operatorname{SPC}(m)\otimes\operatorname{SPC}(n)\) codes
